# Asset origins

The `.ogt` assets and camera are written for this fixture and carry the
repository's licence. The stock-brick source image is reused from the
scene-population authoring work for head 5; its four PBR maps were made
with `og materials make`, not downloaded from a texture library. Their
immutable pins are in `og-assets.json`. No commercial game's assets are
included; Watch Dogs: Legion is a visual quality target only.
